ln:4461729303.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Supporting branch improvement initiatives, providing customer feedback of our service, and ensuring compliance with audit requirements and quality assurance

Premier Relationship Director require exceptional ability to build trusting relationships with existing and potential Premier Elite clients, help clients articulate their needs, and deliver to exceed client expectations.

扩大卓越尊尚客户群，并与卓越尊尚客户建立长期关系

根据卓越尊尚客户的财务需求提供合适的金融及投资产品服务，管理客户的财富

向潜在客户推广卓越理财服务，发掘他们的需求并且在适当的情况下推荐客户至其他业务部门

配合执行分行改进措施，反映客户的意见，并确保符合分行的运作要求和品质保证

卓越尊尚客户总监需要具备与现有客户和潜在客户建立互信的关系，帮助客户表达真实需求，以及帮助客户达成期望的能力

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

University level education, preferably in finance, business, or a related discipline

At least 5 years as Relationship Manager.

Experience in client facing environment, with excellent relationship building capability

Strong sales and customer orientation, with good communication and interpersonal skills

High level of customer centricity mindset with dedication to deliver exceptional quality services for customers

Good understanding and strong interest of the financial markets

Mature and independent mindset, able to work effectively under pressure

Strong commercial orientation with acute interpersonal skills

Fluency in Mandarin and English

本科及以上学历，金融、商科或相关学科更佳

至少5年以上客户经理经验

具有前线客户服务经验，善于建立客户关系

具有优秀销售及客户服务技巧，善于沟通及人际交流

以客户为本，致力为客户提供优质服务

了解并对金融市场有浓厚兴趣

成熟独立，能在压力下有良好表现

具有出色商业思维及敏锐人际技巧

普通话及英语流利

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4459180811.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO Platforms

Req ID： 57611

Principal Responsibilities

  • Provide support across the end-to-end delivery and run lifecycle, utilising their skills and expertise to carry out software development, testing and operational support activities with the ability to move between these according to demand.
  • End to end accountability for a product or service, identifying and developing the most appropriate Technology solutions to meet customer needs as part of the Customer Journey
  • Liaise with other engineers, architects, and business stakeholders to understand and drive the product or service’s direction.
  • Establish a digital environment and automate processes to minimize variation and ensure predictable high quality code and data.
  • Create technical test plans and records, including unit and integration tests, within automated test environments to ensure code quality.
  • Provide support to DevOps teams working at all stages of a product or service release/change with a strong customer focus and end to end journeys, ensuring they have an excellent domain knowledge.
  • Working with Ops, Dev and Test Engineers to ensure operational issues (performance, operator intervention, alerting, design defect related issues, etc.) are identified and addressed at all stages of a product or service release / change.
  • Provide support in identification and resolution of all incidents associated with the IT service, as directed by leadership of the DevOps team
  • Ensure service resilience, service sustainability and recovery time objectives are met for all the software solutions delivered.
  • Responsible for automating the continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline within a DevOps Product/Service team driving a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Keep up to date and have expertise on current tools, technologies and areas like cyber security and regulations pertaining to aspects like data privacy, consent, data residency etc. that are applicable

Requirements

  • Extensive IT software engineering experience in software development with Agile methodologies. Experience with frontend and testing is an advantage.
  • Proficient knowledge in GCP and Ali Cloud is essential.
  • Knowledge of “Talk is cheap. Show me the code” --- Linus Torvalds (2000) Hands-on engineering capabilities in state-of-the-art technologies is a must
  • In-depth knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Proficient in containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, including scalable design patterns, security, and performance optimization.
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent team player with the ability to work under pressure with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of working in a fast-paced, globally distributed team environment.
  • Experience in leading a team, conducting code reviews, and test case reviews.
  • Ability to rapidly build and set up PoC environments with Cloud, Container, etc.
  • Proficiency in at least two programming languages, such as Java, Python, Golang, or Node.js.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website./WX

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory
  • 负责中高端客户的开发，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户
  • 通过银行渠道或者自己开发的渠道成功获取新客户
  • 为客户提供优良的服务，完成基本的零售销售指标
  • 与相关业务领域建立牢固的工作关系（如：财富管理及个人银行业务部，市场部）
  • 提供高标准的客户服务，提高客户满意度

Qualifications - Internal

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
  • 本科以上或同等学历
  • 至少一年金融服务或零售经验，或同等工作经验
  • 对各种形式的存款，WEM产品，抵押贷款等产品有充分的了解
  • 对行业法规，消费趋势，竞争对手的产品，经济和外汇市场趋势有较好的了解
  • 较好的演讲和销售技巧
  • 较好的异议处理技巧，能在高压下工作
  • 良好的人际交往和沟通能力
  • 以客户服务为导向
  • 根据市场要求获得适当的专业和监管资格
  • 达到汇丰要求的内部岗位标准

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4490548566.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business: CTO

Job ID：66425

Principal Responsibilities

  • Lead the internal frontend team in developing, delivering, and maintaining CDMS Teller X frontend modules, ensuring engineering quality and alignment with business priorities.
  • Partner with the outsourced delivery partner, to clarify requirements, align technical solutions, manage dependencies, and jointly deliver Teller X enhancements.
  • Lead the phased transition of all frontend development and maintenance responsibilities within the agreed handover scope from deliverty partner to the internal team, ensuring effective knowledge transfer, complete technical documentation, and continuity of delivery and support.
  • Build the internal team’s technical and operational capabilities to independently develop, maintain, and support the frontend functionality transitioned from delivery vendor.
  • Review frontend deliverables from vendor against agreed architecture, coding, testing, and security standards to support a sustainable transition to internal ownership.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with outsourced delivery partners and align internal and external teams on technical standards and delivery commitments.
  • Ability to lead technical knowledge transfer and ownership transitions, enabling internal teams to independently manage ongoing development and production support.
  • Strong hands-on frontend engineering experience, with a proven ability to lead developers and deliver enterprise applications.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, with practical expertise in modern frontend frameworks such as React.
  • Solid experience with frontend architecture, component-based development, state management, routing, and reusable UI patterns.
  • Hands-on expertise in Node.js for supporting services, development tooling, automation, and application integration.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and implementing authentication, authorization, and robust error handling.
  • A strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and frontend security principles.
  • Practical experience with automated testing, code reviews, static analysis, and engineering quality controls.
  • Strong proficiency in Git, including collaborative branching strategies, pull-request workflows, and release management.
  • Confident, practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools for development, testing, troubleshooting, and documentation, with appropriate validation and responsible handling of enterprise data.
  • Experience with frontend build tooling and CI/CD platforms, such as Webpack, Jenkins, and SonarQube, and familiarity with containerized deployment environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting and performance optimization skills, including browser profiling, rendering efficiency, and bundle optimization.
  • Experience delivering solutions from technology selection and design through implementation, deployment, and production support.
  • Ability to understand business requirements and technical documentation in English and translate them into clear, maintainable solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills, with the ownership needed to manage cross-team handovers and lead independent delivery.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited Xian Branch***
